habitat: Pairs and small coveys in rank grass, especially in damp regions within grassland and bushveld.
summary: There is no Harlequin Quail page. The description on the Crested Francolin page is this quail: the male is darker than Common Quail, with bold black markings on a white throat and chestnut underparts. The female has a dark necklace across the throat to the ear coverts. The call is a loud metallic wit, wit-wit, wit, wit-wit-it. Newman says uncommon to fairly common summer resident, a few all year, and nomadic, sometimes irrupting and then disappearing. No length is given in that paragraph. Status and months are unset. The colour key on that page is Crested Francolin and was not used here. The Kemp code VB was left unchanged.

similar.note: Common Quail has pale underparts. The male Harlequin Quail has chestnut underparts and black markings on a white throat.

The Kruger grade A songs are ND. The filename is XC746385-Harliquin Quail singing very good 2022 08 20 Sunbah Farm, Jizan, Saudi Arabia_1832_short.mp3, so the file name says short and spells the bird Harliquin.
